'''TT4''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was used by the company [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]] as an irregular transport specialist. At some point, TT4 contacted a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] on the behalf of Tor-Ro-Bo and hired them to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] some semi-processed [[TOL-type ore]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] to the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Tor 7863]]'', in breach of a [[Profit-Sharing Agreement Relaali 374.5.2|profit-sharing agreement]] that Tor-Ro-Bo had signed with the other corporations that operated on 244Core.<ref name="Imminent Impact" />
